'''Fortune''' is an [[enchantment]] for mining tools that increases block drops. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] its maximum level is I; higher Fortune comes only from [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tools, whose intrinsic works as Fortune up to level III.

== Obtaining ==
* The [[Prayer of Midas]], a crafted [[blessing]], stores Fortune I with Looting III.
* Random enchanted books and trial chamber vaults. Because the maximum level is I, no book can hold more.

== Behavior ==
Fortune works as vanilla Fortune I. Its maximum level is lowered from III to I, so it cannot be raised by combining books in an [[anvil]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/fortune.json}}</ref> The pack adds the electrum tool intrinsic to the same exclusive set as Fortune and Silk Touch, so a tool can have only one of the three.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/mining.json}}</ref> The pack's block loot tables check for both Fortune and the electrum intrinsic, but three of them don't apply it: the raw gold entry of stone [[Native Gold|native gold]] is written in the pre-26.3 loot format, which the game doesn't read, and the [[tomatoes|tomato]] and [[chorus fruit|chorus plant]] tables set a fixed count after the bonuses, which replaces them.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/beetroots.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/chorus_plant.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]]. On fully grown [[carrot]]s, Fortune adds one more chance of an extra carrot.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/carrots.json}}</ref>

Fortune has no effect on [[spawner]]s: each gives exactly one [[pith]].

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 4.
